title: Timeline reconstruction method
body:
Reconstruct what happened, in order, from evidence:

1. Anchor on a known event (the alert, a confirmed malicious login, a file write) and its timestamp. Record it as a timeline fact with ts/actor/action/evidence_ref.
2. Work outward in both directions: what happened just before (initial access, the preceding auth) and just after (what the actor did next).
3. One source of truth per claim: cite the exact log line or artifact in evidence_ref. A timeline entry with no cited evidence is a hypothesis, not a fact.
4. Normalize clocks: note each source's timezone; convert to one reference zone before ordering.
5. On every newly confirmed foothold (a compromised account or host), re-enumerate: it is new surface, and the next event usually hides one hop past the last.
6. Stop when the story is continuous from initial access to current state, or when a gap needs evidence you must go collect.

The output is an ordered set of timeline facts plus findings that cite them.
